name: motion-camera-roll
title: Roll
description: Cả khung nghiêng chưa tới 1° trong tích tắc khi có cú va rồi về thẳng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.decay: s back to level, ease-out cubic (0.24)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Hit accent: the whole frame rotates 0 -> 0.9 deg in 60 ms and back to 0 by 300 ms ease-out (easeOutCubic). Demo exaggerates it as a continuous roll of +-4.6 deg (0.08 rad) on a 3 s sine. Params: angle (0.9°) · attack (60 ms) · decay (0.24 s). Call it once per hit. The demo exaggerates the angle (2.5°) so the roll reads on a small preview, as the small demo does.
moworks.titleVi: Khung nghiêng nhẹ khi va chạm
